modules.module_title: Prepare for erecting scaffold using pipe and coupler

pcs.pc_description: prepare the base by levelling and compacting the ground for the erection of scaffold as directed by the supervisor
select, shift and stack required quantity of materials, components at the work location as per the instructions
set up barricades in the work area and fix guard rails and safety nets to ensure safety
assist in marking, transferring levels from reference points using water level tube
check the condition of coupler, pipes and fixtures for any bend and deviation from shape and report to the supervisor

modules.module_title: Erect scaffold using pipe and coupler

pcs.pc_description: select swivel coupler, right angle coupler (fixed coupler) based on the scaffold fixing requirements and supervisor’s instructions
select pipes based on nominal bore diameter and length and check for any bend in pipes
erect scaffold using pipes and coupler in a sequential manner and provide necessary support using suitable components as per the instructions
fix the coupler and clamps tightly as per the instructions
assist in aligning and providing support to scaffold as per the instructions
assist in checking the verticality of scaffold
place and fix appropriate plank or walk board, guard rail, toe board and other accessories for working on scaffolding

modules.module_title: Dismantle the scaffold

pcs.pc_description: assist in dismantling scaffold and lowering scaffold materials in a sequential manner safely as per the given instructions
carry out maintenance of scaffold materials, such as cleaning and minor repairs, for further use
follow the applicable safety and housekeeping standards and procedures

modules.module_title: Prepare for erecting common customized system scaffold

pcs.pc_description: prepare the base by levelling and compacting the ground for the erection of scaffold as directed by the supervisor
select, shift and stack required quantity of materials and components at the work location as per the instructions
set up barricades in the work area, and fix guard rails and safety nets to ensure safety
assist in marking and transferring levels from reference points using water level tube
check the condition of scaffolding components before use and report the repair and maintenance needs to the supervisor

modules.module_title: Erect the common customized system scaffold

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate components based on the type of scaffold
position the sole board/base plates on the ground as per the marking
set up the relevant fixtures and components as per selected system and supervisor’s instructions
erect scaffold in a sequential manner and provide necessary support as per the instructions
assist in shifting components from the lower to upper level using the appropriate lifting tools and equipment
assist in aligning and providing support to scaffold as per the given instructions
assist in checking the verticality of scaffold
set up appropriate plank board or walk boards, guard rail, toe board and other accessories for working platform on the scaffolding

modules.module_title: Dismantle the common customized system scaffold

pcs.pc_description: assist in dismantling scaffold and lowering scaffold materials in a sequential manner safely as per the given instructions
carry out maintenance of scaffold materials, such as cleaning and minor repair
follow the applicable safety and housekeeping standards and procedures
